name: This Afternoon
detailedForecast: Patchy fog and showers and thunderstorms before 2pm, then patchy fog and showers and thunderstorms between 2pm and 5pm, then patchy fog and a slight chance of rain showers. Some of the storms could produce heavy rain. Cloudy, with a high near 72. Southeast wind 3 to 7 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between 1 and 2 inches possible.
